SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT

S.1, Special Branch. File No. Date May 22, 1941.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
SPECIAL REGISTRY
No. 865
23/ 5/ 41）

SUBJECT: Mrs. Annetta Ottolenghi -
enquiries re

With reference to the attached letter
from Mrs. Muriel Major, New York City, U.S.A.,
asking for information regarding Mrs. Annetta
Ottolenghi, Italian, it has been ascertained that
the lady in question is living at Room 7, House 16
1227 Yu Yuen Road, and is known in Shanghai as
Mrs. Luca, profession - artist.

The contents of the letter were made
known to Mrs. Ottolenghi who expressed considerable
doubt as to the authenticity of the request since
she is not familiar with the name of the writer of
the letter, although she remembers a transient
acquaintanceship in Rome two years ago with a person
who claimed to be a distant cousin, and whose
christian name was 'Muriel'.

In view of the distrust with which
Mrs. Ottolenghi views the object of the letter she
requests that her address be not divulged to
Mrs. Major but that she be told that enquiries
should be made through the Italian Consulate in
Shanghai.

The name and address of Mrs. Muriel Major
were given to Mrs. Ottolenghi at her request.

by y/s:

A. C. (Special Branch)

（签名：G Reynolds
D. P. B.）

(S. R.) REGISTRY
DATE 23/ 5 / 41）

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
报告

S.1，特别支部。档案编号。日期：1941年5月22日。

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处
特别登记处
第 865 号
1941年5月23日）

事由：关于安妮塔·奥托伦吉夫人（Mrs. Annetta Ottolenghi）的查询——

兹提及附上的来自美利坚合众国纽约市穆里尔·梅杰夫人（Mrs. Muriel Major）的信件，信中询问有关意大利籍安妮塔·奥托伦吉夫人的信息。经查明，该女士现居住于愚园路1227号16幢7室，在上海以卢卡夫人（Mrs. Luca）之名为人所知，职业为艺术家。

信中之内容已告知奥托伦吉夫人，她对该请求的真实性表示极大怀疑，因为她并不熟悉写信人的姓名，尽管她记得两年前在罗马曾与一名自称是远房表亲、教名为“穆里尔”的人有过短暂的相识。

鉴于奥托伦吉夫人对该信件目的持不信任态度，她请求不要向梅杰夫人透露其地址，而是告知对方应通过意大利驻上海领事馆进行查询。

应奥托伦吉夫人的要求，已将穆里尔·梅杰夫人的姓名和地址告知她。

由 y/s：

A. C. （特别支部）

（签名：G Reynolds
D. P. B.）

（印：索引编制者
(S. R.) 登记处
日期 1941年5月23日）

May 24, 41.

Mrs. Muriel Major,
42 W. 92 Street,
New York City,
U. S. A.

Madam,

With reference to your letter dated April
16, 1941, I have to refer you to the Italian Consul-
General in Shanghai for the information you require.

Yours faithfully,

K. M. BOURNE
K. M. Bourne
Commissioner of Police.
